notes.title: Global Launch Update
notes.content:
[p]We’re dashing into your feed today with an update on Sonic Rumble’s Global Launch and to answer the question on everyone’s mind: when will we open the floodgates to the chaotic, toy-filled world of Sonic Rumble?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332266/c323d0ef6fb1a02923f4807d24f608adbe480d35.png"][/img]
[/p][p]Many of you have been wondering why the game hasn’t been released globally yet, even though it may seem ready. We’re very close and determined to fine-tune Sonic Rumble to ensure the best possible experience once we launch on a global scale. There’s still so much exciting content in the works that we haven’t revealed yet. From new characters, challenging stages, exciting features, to the most amazing crossover events, the team is building even more ways to keep the action fresh and fun.[/p][p][/p][p]A big focus right now is making sure the experience is even better for new players who haven’t had the chance to play yet, so some of these changes might not be as visible to those who tried the game in its early stages. We feel a special responsibility to get this right for the entire Sonic community and to deliver a competitive, party multiplayer experience that keeps everyone, new and returning players alike, happy and engaged.[/p][p][/p][p]The team is making incredible progress toward Global Launch in 2025, and we can’t wait to show you everything we’ve been building. We are more excited than ever to welcome you all into the game later this year. Thank you for sticking with us on this journey. Your support keeps us moving full speed ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]- The Sonic Rumble Team[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]Please note that the store pages might indicate a specific date for Sonic Rumble's release. However, this is a placeholder date. The actual release date for the Sonic Rumble Global Launch will be revealed at a later date.[/i][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Update
notes.content: [h2]New Stages[/h2][list][*][p]More stages will be added in the future![/p][/*][/list][h2]New Co-Op Battle Mode[/h2][list][*][p]Take on the Death Queen in our newest Co-Op Mode![/p][/*][/list][h2]New Stage Challenges[/h2][p]Added the following Stage Challenges:[/p][list][*][p]Green Hill Run 2[/p][/*][*][p]Frozen Factory Run 2[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Crew Feature[/h2][list][*][p]When you join a Crew, you can communicate and play together with your friends.[/p][/*][*][p]In addition, you can receive daily rewards and participate in special missions available only to Crew members.[/p][/*][*][p]Join forces with your Crew members to earn phenomenal rewards![/p][/*][/list][h2]Rumble Ranking[/h2][list][*][p]Rumble Rankings is a new ranking system where you compete with other players in the same active league for the highest score.[/p][/*][*][p]The rewards you can obtain get better and better the higher you get your rank and league bracket to.[/p][/*][*][p]Aim for the top ranks by upgrading your Skin and Buddy Score Bonuses![/p][/*][*][p]With the addition of Rumble Rankings, Season Ranking rewards will be discontinued.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Skills Feature[/h2][list][*][p]A new Skills feature has been added that allows you to perform various actions while playing a stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Skills include effects such as increased movement speed, the ability to attack other players, and the ability to draw nearby Rings towards you.[/p][/*][*][p]Equip your favorite character with Skills to gain an advantage in battle![/p][/*][/list][h3]Acquiring Skills[/h3][list][*][p]Skills can mainly be obtained via purchases at the Skill Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]To purchase Skills, you will need Skill Stars, which can be earned through missions and other activities.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Enhancing Skills[/h3][list][*][p]Skills have levels, and leveling them up strengthens their effects.[/p][/*][*][p]You will need Skill Stars to level up Skills. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes to Enhancement Materials[/h2][list][*][p]The enhancement materials for Skins, Buddies, and Emotes have been changed to Tune-Up Wrenches.[/p][/*][*][p]As a result, the previous enhancement materials Slot Keys, Emote Pieces, and Fruit will be discontinued. [/p][/*][*][p]Rewards in various areas have been adjusted to reflect these changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Any discontinued Enhancement Materials that you possess will be lost, but you will be compensated by the same amount in Tune-Up Wrenches. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes to the Cosmetic Progression Feature[/h2][h3]Skins & Buddies[/h3][list][*][p]The function to unlock equipment slots has been removed, and upgrading will now increase the Score Bonus value.[/p][/*][*][p]The Grade function for Skins has been removed and a new Level feature has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Leveling up Skins and Buddies increases their Score Bonus values.[/p][/*][*][p]The system where Score Bonuses activated based on conditions or slots has been removed. Instead, the total Score Bonus value of all owned Skins and Buddies will be applied in battles.[/p][/*][*][p]The Enhancement levels of Skins and Buddies have been reset to coincide with these changes to the specifications. However, you will be compensated by the same amount reset in the form of Tune-Up Wrenches. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Emotes[/h3][list][*][p]With the introduction of Skills, the upgrade and Score Bonus functions for Emotes have been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Based on these changes to the specifications, you will be compensated by the same amount lost in the form of Tune-Up Wrenches.[/p][/*][*][p]Additionally, some Emotes will be re-released as Skills. (Punch, Kick, and more)[/p][/*][*][p]If you own any of the affected Emotes, they will be converted into Skills after the update.[/p][/*][*][p]Emotes that will be changed into Skills and were purchased with Red Star Rings.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill Stars will be granted as compensation for the discontinuation of Emote Score Bonuses.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Epic Emotes (99 Red Star Rings): 990 Skill Stars will be granted.[/p][list][*][p]Eligible Emotes: Ground Punch, Finger Wag, Tail Copter, Shadowbox, Piko Piko Hammer, Crossed Arms, Hi There!, Overdrive, Charge!, Psychic Burst, Pyrokinesis, Jolly Flip, Goggle Fix, Booming Laugh, Time to Crash, Energy Ball, Overheat, Levitation, EX Gear Rush, Hammer Down[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Legendary Emotes (149 Red Star Rings): 1,490 Skill Stars will be granted. [/p][list][*][p]Eligible Emotes: Breakdance, Volcanic Dunk, PDA Scan, Chaos Spear, Pyrotechnics, Hammer Attack, Screw Kick, Take Flight, World-Famous Treasure Hunter, Burrow[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Changes to Score Rank Rewards[/h2][list][*][p]Rewards will now include Skills such as Stomp Attack, Baseball Slide, Kick, and Tackle.[/p][/*][*][p]Users who created an account by May 7th maintenance will receive the Skills Baseball Slide and Stomp Attack as compensation. [/p][/*][/list][h2]Additional Improvements to Existing Features[/h2][list][*][p]Improved the UI and Ease of Play[/p][/*][*][p]Skin Filter Feature Added [/p][/*][*][p]Customization Points Removed[/p][/*][*][p]Advertising Features Added [/p][/*][*][p]Feature to Automatically Claim Mission Rewards Added[/p][/*][*][p]Explanation of Controls Added to Home Screen [/p][/*][/list][h2]Homescreen Blur Setting[/h2][list][*][p]A highly requested setting has been added that allows you to toggle the blur effect on the Home Screen. You can find it under: [/p][list][*][p][b]Settings ⇒ Graphics ⇒ Home Screen Settings[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Display background without blur: ON / OFF[/b] [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Changing this setting will prompt a game restart and may trigger an additional background asset download[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Sonic Rumble Global Launch Postponement Announcement
notes.content:
We’d like to update you on the status of Sonic Rumble’s Global Launch. Over the past few months, we’ve been working hard to bring the game to life, and we’re incredibly grateful for the valuable feedback we’ve received from players during the Pre-Launch period. The excitement and positive response from all of you has been truly amazing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332266/c323d0ef6fb1a02923f4807d24f608adbe480d35.png[/img]

Thanks to your incredible support, we’ve surpassed 1.4 million pre-registrations, a milestone that speaks volumes about your passion for Sonic Rumble. With this level of excitement, we feel an even greater responsibility to deliver an experience worthy of your time.

We’re also very proud of the amazing positive response Sonic Rumble has already received, with App Store ratings averaging 4.8.

As we prepare for Update 1.2, we’ll be introducing several exciting new features:

[list]
[*] [b]Rumble Ranking[/b] – Compete within your league and earn rewards. 
[*] [b]Crews[/b] – Team up with fellow Rumblers and take on the score missions together. 
[*] [b]Skills[/b] – Equip characters with unique abilities, adding a new layer of gameplay depth. 
[/list]
We’ll be sharing more details about these new features in the coming days, so even if you can’t participate yet, you’ll be able to stay in the loop and share your thoughts with us.

These upcoming changes will fundamentally reshape the game, and one thing has become clear: We want to create a game that evolves and stays fun for months and years to come. To build the kind of high-quality, long-lasting Sonic game our players deserve, we need more time.

As a result, we’ve decided to postpone the Global Launch. We know this news may be disappointing, and it wasn’t a decision we made lightly. We at SEGA share that disappointment, especially because we’re making this call so close to the launch timing we had originally hoped for. However, we believe taking this extra time is the right choice for the future of Sonic Rumble.

We don’t have a new release date to share yet, but as soon as we get closer, we’ll update you through our social media and community channels.

When we say your support means the world to us, we truly mean it. A strong community sticks together, and we’d love for you to join us for a special [b]Q&A session on Discord[/b], scheduled for May 2 at 1:00 PM UTC / 6:00 AM PDT / 4:00 PM EEST. We’ll answer your questions about the new features, the delay, the next steps, and more!

Your love and support mean the world to us. We are truly grateful.

- The Sonic Rumble Team


[i]Please note that the store pages might indicate a specific date for Sonic Rumble's release. However, this is a placeholder date. The actual release date for the Sonic Rumble Global Launch will be revealed at later date.
[/i]

notes.title: Coming This Spring—With Exciting New Game Modes and Features!
notes.content:
Sonic Rumble is coming this spring! Before it crosses the global release finish line, we're packing it with some exciting new content and features to deliver the best experience for our players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332266/df30e6301d7e8f1a51659d3f2ae7bd76ac068d40.png[/img]

Here's a sneak peek at what's coming soon:

[list]
[*] [b]Quick Rumble[/b] - Just want to hop in and play? We've got you covered. Quick Rumble provides a bite sized one-round challenge for when you're short on time.
[*] [b]Rival Rank[/b] - A new competitive mode where you can prove yourself and earn extra rewards.
[*] [b]New "Crews" Feature[/b] - Band together to take on the competition and earn even more rewards.
[/list]
But that's not all. We're making Sonic Rumble truly unique by embracing the abilities of your favorite characters from across Sonic's universe. Ever wanted to stun rivals with Amy's Piko Piko Hammer? Now you can! Selected characters get a set of unique abilities to shake up the competition.

We would like to extend a huge thank you to our players and Sonic fans for their patience in waiting for the global launch of Sonic Rumble. The team is committed to delivering a memorable experience for Sonic fans with even more new game mechanics, new features, and more exciting content to look forward to.

More details will be released as we get closer to Global Launch, but In the meantime join the community on [url=https://sonicrumble.com/twitter]Twitter[/url], [url=https://sonicrumble.com/facebook]Facebook[/url], [url=https://sonicrumble.com/instagram]Instagram[/url], subscribe to us on [url=https://sonicrumble.com/youtube]YouTube[/url] or [url=https://sonicrumble.com/tiktok]TikTok[/url], or jump to [url=https://sonicrumble.com/Discord]Discord[/url] for exclusive content.

[b]Sonic Rumble launches this Spring on iOS, Android, Google Play Games on PC, and Steam.[/b]
